Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is all we have from this match and from the 2022 T20 World Cup Qualifier A as well. It's been a fascinating few days of cricketing action. Two sides have made it through to the preliminary stages of the T20 World Cup later in the year in Australia. The winners, UAE will join Sri Lanka and Namibia in Group A whereas Ireland will be a part of Group B which includes West Indies and Scotland. Hope you enjoyed the coverage. Take care and goodbye!
A big moment now as Ahmed Raza is presented the winning trophy which he lifts with his team. All the members seem elated and pose for a team photograph as well.

The winning captain, Ahmed Raza says that Aravind is a special kid and he has been the reason for their success in this tournament. Adds that the opposition were still 20 runs or so short and they had a simple chat at the interval to chase it down as the pitch was a belter. Mentions that they were disappointed to miss out on the home World Cup last year but they have bounced back now and he congratulates Waseem for his brilliant ton today. He then goes on to thank all the curators and the opposition skipper for making it through to the World Cup and hopes that both sides can make it through to the Super 8 stage.

Vriitya Aravind is the PLAYER OF THE SERIES for his exceptional effort with the blade. He says, he doesn't mind if he doesn't score but all that matters it to get the side over the line. Mentions, all the senior players supported the youngsters in the camp. Adds that all he could think about going to Australia and that motivated him to perform at such a high level. Ends by saying, they aren't going to go there just to participate but they will make sure to give a solid fight and make it into the main World Cup stage.

Waseem Muhammad is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his match-winning knock. He says that he is grateful for the opportunity given to him, whether he is scoring runs or not, the team had confidence in him. He adds that the captain just told him to stay on the crease for as long as possible and he is glad to have played well today. Mentions that his elbow is fine at the moment and ends by saying that he is very excited to play the World Cup in Australia.

Irish skipper, Andy Balbirnie is in for a chat. He says, they played really good cricket and he congratulates them for their effort. Mentions, 159 was not enough, it was a pretty good wicket and they wanted more by the end of it. Adds, the best of the day won. He says that the focus is now on Australia. They have a lot of work to do and they are excited about it. Ends by thanking everyone for producing such a lovely event.
... Presentation ceremony ...

Earlier in the day, the Irish tail fought valiantly to get their side to a competitive total of 159 runs. This was well backed up by Josh Little who gave them a brilliant start with the ball. This was all washed away as Waseem Muhammad turned on the heat on what was already a very scorching day and notched up his second T20I ton. United Arab Emirates end up becoming the champions of the 2022 T20 World Cup Qualifiers A. Stay tuned for the presentation ceremony.

Well, 159 didn't seem enough but Ireland had all the momentum coming into the chase. They made it count as Josh Little got two wickets in the 4th over and the Irish bogged down their opponents inside the Powerplay. However, the lack of control from the spinners in the middle overs really cost them. Ireland could not pick up another wicket until it was too late and their bowlers were smashed to all parts of the ground by Waseem Muhammad. In the end, it was a disappointing effort in the field and the trophy that seemed to be theirs at one point slipped out of their grasp. They finish second and will now head into Group B of the preliminary stage of the 2022 T20 World Cup.

United Arab Emirates lost a bit of momentum going into the interval and were reeling at 12/2 inside 4 overs. They seemed to have let the final slip out of their grabs but Waseem Muhammad stepped up big time. He was very well supported by Rohan Mustafa who played very smartly and even hit the winning runs in the end. The pair added on 141 runs for the third wicket and Waseem became just the 10th man to score more than one T20I century, both of them coming against Ireland. Waseem got out at the death but he had already sealed the deal and UAE won the 2022 T20 World Cup Qualifier A!

What a topsy-turvy and cracking final this has been! In the end, it's one man who has made all the difference and that man is Waseem Muhammad. What a sensational knock he has played in the final to bring the trophy home for United Arab Emirates!
A length ball, on middle and leg. Rohan Mustafa tucks it to mid-wicket and scampers through for a quick single. UAE WIN THE GAME BY 7 WICKETS.
A length ball, on off. Rohan Mustafa swings hard at it. The ball takes the outside edge and runs down to third man. They take a brace.
FOUR! Rohan Mustafa applying the finishing touches now. Back of a length, outside off. Rohan Mustafa stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
A length ball, on off, blocked out.
Basil Hameed is in at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hearthbreak for Waseem Muhammad, he would've wanted to end the game here, but his departure is fitting, as all the players and the fans are on their feet greeting him with a standing ovation as he trudges off the field. Fired in full and outside off. Waseem looks to cream it through covers but hits it uppishly and straight to the Irish captain. Andy Balbirnie takes a sharp catch at the cover region and Waseem has to depart after a sensational knock.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy Balbirnie b Andy McBrine

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BANG! Floated, full and on off. Waseem Muhammad stays back and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Full and on off. Rohan Mustafa lofts it over the bowler's head for just one to long off.
LEG BYE! Floated, full and on leg. Waseem Muhammad looks to sweep it away. The ball goes to fine leg off his pads. The cross for a leg bye.
Flighted, full and on leg. Rohan Mustafa looks to sweep it away but gets it to fine leg off the inside edge. The batters take three runs.
Full and on leg. Waseem Muhammad flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
It's the leg-break now, around off. Waseem Muhammad edges it down to third man for a single.
Bye! Through everyone! Quicker, around off. Mustafa misses the drive and the keeper fails to collect. The batters scamper through for a bye.
Flatter, around off. This is pushed towards cover for a single.
On off, Waseem Muhammad blocks it out watchfully.

FOUR! ONE HUNDRED FOR WASEEM MUHAMMAD. What a knock by him. He just loves batting against Ireland. This is his second ton against the Irish side. Floated, full and on leg. Waseem Muhammad flicks it through square leg for a boundary. Waseem Muhammad is leading his side to the finish line here.
A length ball, outside off. Waseem Muhammad punches it to point for a brace.

This does not look good for UAE. Waseem Muhammad is batting on 97 and has taken his team so close to victory but he seems to have got a blow on the elbow. That is nasty to be honest and the physio is out to have a look. The elbow has swollen up and we hope that Waseem is fine. The right elbow is being strapped up and Waseem wants to continue, he wants that ton. Amazing spirit from the guy.
Slightly short and on off. Waseem Muhammad guides it to third man for a single. It comes off the inside edge and hits him on his elbow on it's way. Waseem Muhammad looks to be in some pain.
Full length, outside off. Rohan Mustafa drives it along the ground to long off. They take a single.
A slower bouncer, on off. Waseem Muhammad works it to square leg for one. 30 needed now.
FOUR! What a shot! Waseem Muhammad moves to 95. A full-length ball, on off. Waseem Muhammad lofts it over the bowler's head and bags a boundary at long off.
Back of a length, outside off. Rohan Mustafa shuffles across and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A short ball, on middle. Waseem Muhammad rides the bounce and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched up, on off. This is pushed towards mid on for another single. Waseem Muhammad moves into the 90s now. 37 needed now off the final 30 deliveries.
Leg bye! Back of a length, angled in from around off. Mustafa backs away and looks to tap it towards point but gets it off the pads. The batters scamper through for a leg bye.
Length again, on off. Pushed towards mid off for a quick single.
A length ball, close to the off pole. Waseem Muhammad looks to run it fine but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Full and wide, Waseem Muhammad opens the face of the blade and steers it towards deep point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Waseem Muhammad displaying his full range of shots now. A length ball, angled in from 'round the stumps. Muhammad just glides it past short third man and the ball races away into the fence.
On off, Waseem Muhammad dabs it down to backward point for a quick run. 18 off the over, an expensive one from Simi Singh.
Fired into middle and leg. Mustafa brooms it towards deep square leg for one more.
The leg-break now, on off. Muhammad just pushes it through covers for a single. Smart batting.

SIX! Waseem Muhammad is doing it all on his own here! Right in the slot, on off. Waseem gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps it well over the square leg fence for another monster hit. Just 49 needed now off 39 balls and UAE still have 8 wickets in hand. Ireland need wickets here.
WIDE! Full and wide, a bit too wide though. Wide called.
SIX! It's carnage out in the middle at the moment! Tossed up, outside off. Waseem Muhammad goes inside-out and lofts it over the extra cover fence for a huge hit.
Good running! A googly now, on middle. Waseem Muhammad just knocks it through mid on and races back for the second.
Simi Singh is back into the attack now.
Well bowled! A slower bumper this time, on leg. Mustafa makes room to tap it away but gets undone by the lack of pace.
Full, on the pads and clipped past square leg for one.
SIX! Waseem Muhammad is playing a blinder here! Back of a length, on off and Muhammad is waiting for it. He hangs back and powers it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Back of a length, a bit of width on offer. Rohan Mustafa slaps it to deep cover for just a single.
Back of a length, around off. Muhammad winds up for the big shot but heaves it down to wide long on for a run.
Slower one, pitched up on middle. Mustafa just pushes it towards mid off for a single.

FOUR! 17 off the over, a good one for UAE! Sliding down leg, Waseem Muhammad flicks it past short fine leg and beats the chasing fielder from deep square leg to pick up another boundary. 74 needed now off 48 balls.
Tossed up, on middle. Mustafa knocks it down to long on and turns the strike over.
Gets away with one does Gareth Delany. Dragged down again, Muhammad looks to hit it a bit too hard and mistimes it towards deep square leg for just a single.
FOUR! And again! Dragged down, around leg. Waseem Muhammad pulls it hard and behind square for a boundary. That's the fifty up for Muhammad and he has changed gears really quickly.
SIX! A rank long hop and duly punished! Dragged down on middle, Waseem Muhammad hangs back and muscles it way, way over the mid-wicket fence for a huge hit.
On a length, around off. Mustafa steps out and gets an inside edge onto the off side. The batters take one.
Gareth Delany to roll his arm now.
Darted on the pads. Rohan Mustafa tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, on leg. Waseem Muhammad clips it to fine leg for a single.
A bit fuller and outside off. Waseem Muhammad tries to defend it out but misses.
Fuller, on off. Rohan Mustafa lofts it towards long off for one.
Fuller and on leg. Waseem Muhammad sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
SIX! All the way! Flighted, full and on off. Waseem Muhammad get low and slog-sweeps it over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
On the pads. Waseem Muhammad flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off. Waseem Muhammad drills it to long on for a brace.

The Irish players are looking for the ball in the stands! It's an empty stadium and there's no media personnel either in the stands, so, a couple of Irish players are out searching for it. They don't find it and the umpires call for a set of used balls to be brought out. They have their pick and we are ready to continue.
SIX! BANG! Waseem Muhammad freeing his arms now. Tossed up, full and on off. Waseem Muhammad gets under it and smokes it over the long on fence for a biggie.
A single now as this is worked through mid-wicket.
WIDE! Full and down leg. Mustafa leaves it alone. Wided.
Full and on the pads. Waseem Muhammad flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, worked towards mid on for a single.
On off, pushed to point for a single.
Floated, full and on off. Rohan Mustafa works it to wide long on for a brace.
On off, pushed to covers but not in the gap.
WIDE! Angled down the leg side. Rohan Mustafa leaves it alone. Wide called.
Full and on off. Waseem Muhammad taps it to point for a single.
Flighted, full and on off. Waseem Muhammad pushes it to cover.
Full and on off. Rohan Mustafa pushes it to mid off for one.
Spin from both ends now as Simi Singh is brought into the attack.
Short and on off. Mustafa punches it down the ground to long off for a single.
A single as this is eased towards mid on.
Fuller, outside off. Waseem Muhammad prods and drives it to the man at cover.
Flatter and on off. Mustafa shuffles across and flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated, full and on leg. Waseem Muhammad tucks it to mid-wicket for an easy single.
Flatter and on the pads. Rohan Mustafa flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Spin for the first time as Andy McBrine is brought into the attack.
Full length, on off. Rohan Mustafa pushes it to cover with soft hands for a quick single.
Full length, on off. Waseem Muhammad guides it towards backward point for a single.
Length ball, on the pads. Mustafa flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
A slower ball, full and on off. Waseem Muhammad comes forward and defends it to the leg side for a quick single.
FOUR! Nicely played. Waseem Muhammad is on a roll. Full length, on middle and leg. Waseem Muhammad drills it towards wide long on for a boundary.

SIX! OH DEAR! Shane Getkate with a great effort in the deep. A ful-length ball, on middle and leg. Waseem Muhammad heaves it to deep mid-wicket. Shane Getkate settles under it and takes a sharp catch near the ropes but his momentum takes him inside the ropes and the umpire raises both his arms to signal a maximum.
A length ball, on off. Mustafa pushes it to cover. At the end of the Powerplay, United Arab Emirates are 21/2!
Around off, Muhammad nudges it down to short third man for a single.

Huge mix-up but Rohan Mustafa survives! A length ball, around off. Muhammad looks to run it fine but edges it down to the keeper. Mustafa is eager to get back on strike and is halfway down the track. The keeper misses the shy at the bowler's end otherwise Mustafa wasn't even in the picture.
A yorker now, angled into middle and leg. Rohan Mustafa gets an inside edge towards short fine leg. They scamper through for a single.
Full and angling across off, this is edged down to short third man for a single by Waseem Muhammad.
Full and wide, this is squeezed towards point.
FOUR! Just a bit of width on offer and Rohan Mustafa throws his hands at it. He gets it through point and picks up a much-needed boundary for his side.
Pitched up, on off. This is pushed straight to short cover. United Arab Emirates feeling the pressure out there at the moment.
Full, around off. Mustafa can't get it through covers.
Slanting down leg, Waseem Muhammad flicks it down to fine leg for a single.
A length ball, on middle. Defended out.

Rohan Mustafa survives twice on the same delivery! A length ball, around leg and skidding through. Mustafa looks to tuck it leg side but gets an inside edge back onto the pads. The Irish team is convinced that he is a goner but the umpire remains unmoved. The batters scamper through for one and the fielder misses the shy at the bowler's end. If he hit, Mustafa was a goner.
Around middle and leg. Blocked out.
Rohan Mustafa is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Huge, huge wicket this as Vriitya Aravind, the man in form goes for a duck! Short of a length, on the body and this one hurries on to the batter. Vriitya Aravind tries to take Josh Little on but is late in his pull shot. The ball goes off the top edge and skies towards the mid-wicket fence. Simi Singh settles under it, juggles the ball a couple of times but more importantly for Ireland, holds onto the catch. Josh Little has given his team a dream start here.
Commentary.Howout: c Simi Singh b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: On a good length, around off and tapped towards point.
Vriitya Aravind is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Chirag Suri's edgy stay at the crease comes to a pre-mature end! It's the off-cutter from Josh Little. Little bangs it into the deck, around leg. Suri stays deep in his crease and looks to pull it away. The ball doesn't quite come on and Suri hits it straight down the throat of Simi Singh on the mid-wicket and he makes no mistake. Ireland have the breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Simi Singh b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, on leg stump. Chirag Suri looks to hang back and pull but gets hurried on and the ball hits him on the body.
Leg bye! On the pads, Waseem Muhammad looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off the pads onto the off side and they scamper through for a leg bye.
Fullish delivery, on middle. Waseem Muhammad wrists it towards mid-wicket for one more. A slow and steady start here from UAE at the moment.
Drop and run! On off, played with soft hands onto the off side for a quick single by Suri.
Leg bye! Length this time, nipping back in from around off. Waseem Muhammad looks to defend it out but misses. The ball hits the thigh pad and rolls onto the off side. They get a leg bye.
Pitched up, on off and Muhammad drives it straight towards mid off.
A length ball, around off. This is cutaway down to third man for just a single.
Good fielding! Full and straight, thumped back towards the bowler who sticks out a right hand and makes the stop.
FOUR! Slashed away! A bit of width on offer and Waseem Muhammad latches onto it in a flash. He gets it past point and picks up a bundary.
Full, around off. This is pushed towards covers.
This is angled across off, Suri opens the face of the blade and steers it down to third man for a single.
A length ball, on middle. Suri drives on the up and straight towards mid on.
Full and wide, sliced to the left of point where the fielder makes an excellent diving stop.
Full and there's a bit of width on offer. Muhammad slashes it towards covers for a quick region.
Josh Little to share the new ball.
On a good length, on off and nipping back in off the surface. Suri looks to tuck it away but misses and gets hit high on the pads. Just one run off the first over.
First runs of the day for Waseem Muhammad. Length, around off. Muhammad dabs it down on the off side for a quick single.
Peach! This is bowled on a good length, on off. The ball just shoots up off the surface and flies past the outside edge of Muhammad's blade.
On off, pushed towards mid off.
A touch fuller, angling into middle. Waseem Muhammad keeps it out.
Right on the money from Mark Adair! A length ball, on top of off. Muhammad looks to drop and run on the off side but there's no single there.
